sn56.129-130:1.1: evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye pittivisayā cutā devesu paccājāyanti atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā ye pittivisayā cutā niraye paccājāyanti.
sn56.129-130:1.2: evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye pittivisayā cutā devesu paccājāyanti atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā ye pittivisayā cutā tiracchānayoniyā paccājāyanti.
